sprint: Sprint 4 recalibration — regime gate OR → graded (VIX>25 OR VIX>20&spread<0)
verdict: The graded gate (VIX>25 OR VIX>20-with-inverted-curve) fixed Sprint 3's over-exposure problem in direction but not magnitude: 18 of 19 SPREAD_ONLY test months moved back to NEUTRAL, lifting test-window CAGR from +5.41% (Sprint 3 OR) to +6.77% (+1.36pp), yet still 7.05pp shy of the 13.81% baseline — the recalibration recovered only about 16% of the OR gate's test-CAGR gap. 2022 drawdown protection was preserved exactly (-34.23% max DD, identical to Sprint 3 within rounding), confirming Prompt 1's read that the VIX>25 arm is what actually protects the crash months. Against the Sprint 0 baseline the tradeoff is still unacceptable: full-period CAGR at 9.80% is -4.98pp below baseline (outside the 3pp tolerance), full Sharpe 0.530 vs 0.721 (-0.191), and 2022 max DD -34.23% remains 2.49pp short of the primary -31.74% target — so the primary DD check FAILS, both tradeoff checks FAIL, and the risk-on upside is PARTIAL. TimesFM gate: CLOSED — stacking a new momentum factor on a still-Sharpe-reducing gate would confound its evaluation; the SPREAD arm needs further weakening (softer multiplier, or continuous scaling) before Sprint 4 stacks TimesFM.

notes.gate_style: Graded gate — Arm 1: VIX>25 (independent). Arm 2: VIX>20 AND spread<0. Preserved 2022 VIX-only months that a strict AND would have released.
notes.baseline_source: Prompt-stated verified facts (CAGR/Sharpe/Sortino/2022 DD/test Sharpe/test DD). Train Sharpe and full max DD/Calmar/total return read from sprint3_proof_results.json baseline block.
notes.baseline_discrepancy: Sprint 0 full Sharpe: prompt says 0.721, sprint3_proof_results.json says 0.5996. Sortino: prompt ~0.900 vs JSON 0.7477. Used prompt values per instructions; the discrepancy is worth verifying before Prompt 5.
notes.delta_convention: Delta = S4 - other. For drawdowns (negative), positive delta = less-deep = improvement.
